fato_historico: 1359: Peter I of Cyprus ascends the throne of Cyprus after his father, Hugh IV of Cyprus, abdicates.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a meaningful transition, much like the quiet grace of a new crown being passed down. You might find yourself ready to take the helm of a personal project. It is a good time to consider how your authority builds a legacy, grounding your ambitious spirit in lasting, steady growth and true inner sovereignty.
frase_do_dia: True power lies in leading yourself with grace, patience, and a steady heart.
significado_numero: Represents the transformative power of beginnings and personal evolution.
conselho: Trust your intuition and step confidently into the responsibilities you are ready to hold.
